name: 菊草叶
description: 头顶的叶子能感知气温与湿度；轻轻挥动时，还会散发让周围平静下来的香气。
englishDescription: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head. It is docile and loves to soak up sunrays.

name: 月桂叶
description: 脖子上的叶片藏着小小的嫩芽，散发的清新香气能让人振作起来。
englishDescription: The scent of spices comes from around its neck. Somehow, sniffing it makes you want to fight.

name: 大竺葵
description: 花朵的香气能安抚情绪。战斗时，它会用这股香气让对手放松警惕。
englishDescription: The aroma that rises from its petals contains a substance that calms aggressive feelings.

name: 火球鼠
description: 性格胆小，常把身体蜷成一团；受到惊吓时，背上的火焰会猛烈燃起。
englishDescription: It is timid, and always curls itself up in a ball. If attacked, it flares up its back for protection.

name: 火岩鼠
description: 背上的火焰烧不到自己的皮毛。若它突然转身露出背部，就要留意接下来的攻击。
englishDescription: Be careful if it turns its back during battle. It means that it will attack with the fire on its back.

name: 火暴兽
description: 能从背部迸发炽热的火焰，爆发时产生的热浪足以让对手退避。
englishDescription: If its rage peaks, it becomes so hot that anything that touches it will instantly go up in flames.

name: 小锯鳄
description: 虽然个头不大，颚部却格外有力。即使只是玩闹着轻咬，也可能留下深深的牙印。
englishDescription: Its powerful, well-developed jaws are capable of crushing anything. Even its Trainer must be careful.

name: 蓝鳄
description: 一旦咬住目标便不会轻易松口，向后弯曲的尖牙让猎物难以挣脱。
englishDescription: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.

name: 大力鳄
description: 张开巨口威吓对手后，会用强壮的后腿蹬地，迅速向前冲刺。
englishDescription: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.

name: 尾立
description: 同伴睡觉时总有一只负责放哨；一有危险，就立刻叫醒整个群体。
englishDescription: A very cautious Pokémon, it raises itself up using its tail to get a better view of its surroundings.

name: 大尾立
description: 细长的身体可以从狭窄的缝隙钻过，短短的四肢也能支撑它敏捷奔跑。
englishDescription: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other Pokémon to enter.

name: 咕咕
description: 总是在固定的时间鸣叫，因此也有训练家拿它来代替钟表带出门。
englishDescription: It always stands on one foot. It changes feet so fast, the movement can rarely be seen.

name: 猫头夜鹰
description: 开始思考事情时，会将脖子旋转１８０度，以此提高大脑的工作效率。
englishDescription: Its eyes are specially adapted. They concentrate even faint light and enable it to see in the dark.

name: 芭瓢虫
description: 非常胆小的宝可梦。会和伙伴一起张开反射壁来保护巢穴。
englishDescription: It is very timid. It will be afraid to move if it is alone. But it will be active if it is in a group.

name: 安瓢虫
description: 在夜空中飞翔的同时会抛撒闪闪发光的粉末。据说粉末沾到身上就会有好事发生。
englishDescription: When the stars flicker in the night sky, it flutters about, scattering a glowing powder.

name: 圆丝蛛
description: 牙齿上的毒并不强烈，但用来削弱那些挂在网上无法动弹的猎物是绰绰有余了。
englishDescription: It lies still in the same pose for days in its web, waiting for its unsuspecting prey to wander close.

name: 阿利多斯
description: 会通过吐丝来捕捉猎物。到了晚上，就会离开巢穴并积极地狩猎。
englishDescription: It spins string not only from its rear but also from its mouth. It’s hard to tell which end is which.

name: 叉字蝠
description: 可以自由地控制４根翅膀振翅而飞。即使在狭窄的洞窟内也能保持速度飞来飞去。
englishDescription: It flies so silently through the dark on its four wings that it may not be noticed even when nearby.

name: 灯笼鱼
description: 在黑暗的海底，触手上不断闪烁着的光是它们唯一的通信手段。
englishDescription: It shoots positive and negative electricity between the tips of its two antennae and zaps its enemies.

name: 电灯怪
description: 发出强光蒙住猎物的眼睛。抓住那一瞬间的空档，使其遭受电的攻击。
englishDescription: The light it emits is so bright that it can illuminate the sea’s surface from a depth of over three miles.

name: 皮丘
description: 脸颊上的电囊还很小，如果囊里的电太多了，就会漏出来电到自己。
englishDescription: It is not yet skilled at storing electricity. It may send out a jolt if amused or startled.

name: 皮宝宝
description: 有着星星一样的轮廓。由于那外形，人们相信它是乘着流星而来的。
englishDescription: Because of its unusual, starlike silhouette, people believe that it came here on a meteor.

name: 宝宝丁
description: 用柔软的身体弹跳著移动。当它的体温上升时，身体会变成深粉红色。
englishDescription: It has a very soft body. If it starts to roll, it will bounce all over and be impossible to stop.

name: 波克比
description: 好运的象征。据说在它的壳里装着满满的幸福。
englishDescription: The shell seems to be filled with joy. It is said that it will share good luck when treated kindly.

name: 波克基古
description: 不待在温柔的人身边就会变得没有精神。不挥动翅膀也能浮在空中。
englishDescription: They say that it will appear before kindhearted, caring people and shower them with happiness.

name: 天然雀
description: 由于羽翼未丰，所以会跳着移动。一直在注视着什么。
englishDescription: Because its wings aren’t yet fully grown, it has to hop to get around. It is always staring at something.

name: 天然鸟
description: 能够看穿过去和未来。日复一日注视着太阳动向的奇异宝可梦。
englishDescription: They say that it stays still and quiet because it is seeing both the past and future at the same time.

name: 咩利羊
description: 绒毛摩擦产生的电力会被储存起来。如果觉得可爱而直接用手碰它的话，就会被啪地一下电得又麻又痛。
englishDescription: If static electricity builds in its body, its fleece doubles in volume. Touching it will shock you.

name: 茸茸羊
description: 能将电力储存在松软的毛发中。因为储存了太多电力，所以身上有些地方已经变得光秃秃的了。
englishDescription: As a result of storing too much electricity, it developed patches where even downy wool won’t grow.

name: 电龙
description: 尾巴会发出很强的亮光。从以前起，它就被船员们当做路标而深受重视。
englishDescription: The tail’s tip shines brightly and can be seen from far away. It acts as a beacon for lost people.

name: 美丽花
description: 有时能看到美丽花聚在一起做着像是跳舞一样的动作。据说这是呼唤太阳的仪式。
englishDescription: Bellossom gather at times and seem to dance. They say that the dance is a ritual to summon the sun.

name: 玛力露
description: 体毛的防水性能很好，就算是从冰冷的海里上岸，身体也会立刻干掉，一点都不冷。
englishDescription: The tip of its tail, which contains oil that is lighter than water, lets it swim without drowning.

name: 玛力露丽
description: 会制作填满空气的泡泡。当露力丽在河里玩的时候，它就会用这个泡泡包住露力丽。
englishDescription: By keeping still and listening intently, it can tell what is in even wild, fast-moving rivers.

name: 树才怪
description: 为了不被袭击会模仿树的样子。很讨厌水，所以下雨后，不知什么时候就会消失。
englishDescription: Although it always pretends to be a tree, its composition appears more similar to rock than to vegetation.

name: 蚊香蛙皇
description: 雄性的叫声更响亮。叫声低沉可怕的蚊香蛙皇更能受到雌性的欢迎。
englishDescription: If POLIWAG and POLIWHIRL hear its echoing cry, they respond by gathering from far and wide.

name: 毽子草
description: 会随风飘浮。强风将至时，毽子草们会互相勾住叶子，避免被吹散。
englishDescription: To keep from being blown away by the wind, they gather in clusters. But they do enjoy gentle breezes.

name: 毽子花
description: 头顶的花会随着气温升高而开放，花瓣张开的程度也能提示天气的冷暖。
englishDescription: The bloom on top of its head opens and closes as the temperature fluctuates up and down.

name: 毽子棉
description: 搭乘温暖的南风越过大海；遇上冷空气时，便会慢慢降回地面。
englishDescription: Once it catches the wind, it deftly controls its cotton-puff spores--it can even float around the world.

name: 长尾怪手
description: 会从树上寻找猎物。发现喜食的甜竹竹后，就会兴奋地飞扑过去。
englishDescription: Its tail is so powerful that it can use it to grab a tree branch and hold itself up in the air.

name: 向日种子
description: 为了保存进化所需的养分，平时几乎不动，只靠早晨的露水补充水分。
englishDescription: It may plummet from the sky. If attacked by a SPEAROW, it will violently shake its leaves.

name: 向日花怪
description: 把阳光转化为养分，白天活跃地移动；太阳落山后便安静下来。
englishDescription: It converts sunlight into energy. In the darkness after sunset, it closes its petals and becomes still.

name: 蜻蜻蜓
description: 透明的翅膀看起来十分轻薄，振动起来却能掀起强劲的气流。
englishDescription: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.

name: 乌波
description: 为了在地面上行走时不让皮肤干燥，会用有毒的粘膜覆盖身体。
englishDescription: This Pokémon lives in cold water. It will leave the water to search for food when it gets cold outside.

name: 沼王
description: 身体总是滑溜溜的。虽然游泳时头总会撞到河底，但它自己毫不在意。
englishDescription: This carefree Pokémon has an easy-going nature. While swimming, it always bumps into boat hulls.

name: 太阳伊布
description: 从额头的珠子放射出精神力量进行战斗。当力量用尽时，珠子的颜色也会褪去。
englishDescription: It uses the fine hair that covers its body to sense air currents and predict its enemy’s actions.

name: 月亮伊布
description: 在满月之夜或是兴奋的时候，它身上圈圈一样的花纹就会发出金黄色的光。
englishDescription: When agitated, this Pokémon protects itself by spraying poisonous sweat from its pores.

name: 黑暗鸦
description: 会为老大去寻找闪闪发光的东西。据说它很不吉利，厌恶它的人也很多。
englishDescription: Feared and loathed by many, it is believed to bring misfortune to all those who see it at night.

name: 呆呆王
description: 虽然无论向呆呆王提出什么难题它都会帮忙解决，但是谁都无法理解它的语言。
englishDescription: It has incredible intellect and intuition. Whatever the situation, it remains calm and collected.

name: 梦妖
description: 会通过模仿人哭叫的声音来吓唬大家并以此为乐。不擅长对付胆大的对手。
englishDescription: It likes playing mischievous tricks, such as screaming and wailing to startle people at night.

name: 未知图腾
description: 拥有许多形似文字的姿态。它们之间是否存在某种含义，至今仍是谜。
englishDescription: Their shapes look like hieroglyphs on ancient tablets. It is said that the two are somehow related.

name: 果然翁
description: 为了隐藏漆黑的尾巴而悄悄地生活在黑暗之中。不会主动发起攻击。
englishDescription: It hates light and shock. If attacked, it inflates its body to build up its counterstrike.

name: 麒麟奇
description: 尾巴上的小脑袋即使在本体睡觉时也能保持警觉，替它观察身后的动静。
englishDescription: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent by biting.

name: 榛果球
description: 会用唾液将树皮粘在自己身上，从而让自己变得又厚又大。上了年纪的榛果球是无比巨大的。
englishDescription: It likes to make its shell thicker by adding layers of tree bark. The additional weight doesn’t bother it.

name: 佛烈托斯
description: 仅在吞下猎物的瞬间，壳里面的身体才会出现，但至今仍未有人或宝可梦见过其真面目。
englishDescription: Its entire body is shielded by a steel-hard shell. What lurks inside this shell is a total mystery.

name: 土龙弟弟
description: 栖息在像迷宫一样的巢穴里。能通过土壤的气味来判断自己的位置，所以绝对不会迷路。
englishDescription: When spotted, this Pokémon escapes backward by furiously boring into the ground with its tail.

name: 天蝎
description: 会先用身体遮住猎物的视线，再用尾端的毒针发动突袭。
englishDescription: It flies straight at its target’s face, then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.

name: 大钢蛇
description: 人们认为它的身体是因为堆积了很多和泥土一起吞下的铁元素，才会发生变化的。
englishDescription: Its body has been compressed deep under the ground. As a result, it is even harder than a diamond.

name: 布鲁
description: 它和看上去不同，其实很胆小。所以如果把它和小狗宝可梦放在一起，它就有可能会受到欺负。
englishDescription: Although it looks frightening, it is actually kind and affectionate. It is very popular among women.

name: 布鲁皇
description: 虽然深受年轻女性的欢迎，但它胆小怕事，内心柔弱，所以无法成为一条看门犬。
englishDescription: It is actually timid and easily spooked. If attacked, it flails about to fend off its attacker.

name: 千针鱼
description: 全身上下的小针都是由鳞片变化而来的。如果被刺中的话，就会因中毒而昏迷。
englishDescription: To fire its poison spikes, it must inflate its body by drinking over 2.6 gallons of water all at once.

name: 巨钳螳螂
description: 虽然身体纤细，却有着惊人的攻击力。身体的肌肉也是由金属构成的。
englishDescription: It swings its eye-patterned pincers up to scare its foes. This makes it look like it has three heads.

name: 壶壶
description: 储存在壶形甲壳里的树果会在不知不觉间变成黏糊糊的果汁。
englishDescription: The berries it stores in its vase-like shell decompose and become a gooey liquid.

name: 赫拉克罗斯
description: 能轻轻松松地举起比自己体重还重１００倍的东西，是以一身怪力为傲的宝可梦。
englishDescription: This powerful Pokémon thrusts its prized horn under its enemies’ bellies, then lifts and throws them.

name: 狃拉
description: 狡黠凶恶的性格。趁着双亲不在就侵入巢穴，将蛋盗出。
englishDescription: Its paws conceal sharp claws. If attacked, it suddenly extends the claws and startles its enemy.

name: 熊宝宝
description: 掌心常沾着香甜的蜂蜜，因此总爱舔自己的爪子；也会悄悄寻找蜂巢。
englishDescription: If it finds honey, its crescent mark glows. It always licks its paws because they’re soaked with honey.

name: 圈圈熊
description: 擅长在山林里寻找树果。到了食物稀少的季节，觅食中的它会变得格外凶猛。
englishDescription: Although it is a good climber, it prefers to snap trees with its forelegs and eat fallen berries.

name: 熔岩虫
description: 体内流动的不是血液，而是滚烫的熔岩；停下来冷却对它十分危险。
englishDescription: It never sleeps. It has to keep moving because if it stopped, its magma body would cool and harden.

name: 熔岩蜗牛
description: 身体的热量极高，雨滴落上去会立刻蒸发，周围也会升起水雾。
englishDescription: The shell on its back is just skin that has cooled and hardened. It breaks easily with a slight touch.

name: 小山猪
description: 嗅到诱人的香味时，便会不顾一切地朝着气味的方向飞奔过去。
englishDescription: It rubs its snout on the ground to find and dig up food. It sometimes discovers hot springs.

name: 长毛猪
description: 虽然４只脚很短，但因为蹄子很宽很粗糙，所以就算在雪地上行走也不会打滑。
englishDescription: Because the long hair all over its body obscures its sight, it just keeps charging repeatedly.

name: 太阳珊瑚
description: 在温暖的大海里生活。也曾经大量栖息于上古时期的伽勒尔近海。
englishDescription: It continuously sheds and grows. The tip of its head is prized as a treasure because of its beauty.

name: 铁炮鱼
description: 会用变成吸盘状的背鳍吸附在巨翅飞鱼身上，让它分一点吃剩的东西给自己吃。
englishDescription: It has superb accuracy. The water it shoots out can strike moving prey from more than 300 feet away.

name: 章鱼桶
description: 有着结实的坚硬脑袋。会用带吸盘的脚缠住对手，然后再一个劲地用头猛撞。
englishDescription: It traps foes with the suction cups on its tentacles, then smashes them with its rock-hard head.

name: 信使鸟
description: 因为有跟人类及宝可梦分享自己食物的习性，所以一直都在到处寻找食物。
englishDescription: It carries food all day long. There are tales about lost people who were saved by its stored food.

name: 巨翅飞鱼
description: 悠然地畅游在大海中。就算有觊觎食物残渣的铁炮鱼吸附在自己身上也毫不在意。
englishDescription: As it majestically swims, it doesn’t care if REMORAID attach to it for scavenging its leftovers.

name: 盔甲鸟
description: 由于它身上掉落下来的羽毛可以用来制剑，因此作为纹章的图案也很有人气。
englishDescription: Its sturdy wings look heavy, but they are actually hollow and light, allowing it to fly freely in the sky.

name: 戴鲁比
description: 会在天亮之前反复发出恐怖的长嚎，并以此来彰显自己群体的存在。
englishDescription: It uses different kinds of cries for communicating with others of its kind and for pursuing its prey.

name: 黑鲁加
description: 恐怖的长嚎是其特征。过去人们曾认为它是来自地狱的使者而对其心存畏惧。
englishDescription: If you are burned by the flames it shoots from its mouth, the pain will never go away.

name: 刺龙王
description: 身上掉下的鳞片闪耀着高雅而有深度的光泽，甚至会被拿去进献给王族。
englishDescription: It is said that it usually hides in underwater caves. It can create whirlpools by yawning.

name: 小小象
description: 会用长鼻子给自己淋水，也喜欢和同伴互相喷水，玩累后再到水边晾干身体。
englishDescription: It swings its long snout around playfully, but because it is so strong, that can be dangerous.

name: 顿甲
description: 坚硬的身体与强大的力气足以冲开障碍，也会帮助清理挡住山路的落石。
englishDescription: It has sharp, hard tusks and a rugged hide. Its tackle is strong enough to knock down a house.

name: 多边兽２型
description: 在装载了ＡＩ功能后，多边兽２型便开始用只有彼此能懂的神秘语言互相交流了。
englishDescription: This upgraded version of PORYGON is designed for space exploration. It can’t fly, however.

name: 惊角鹿
description: 形状奇特的角会让注视它的人产生眩晕感，因此人们对它的角充满好奇。
englishDescription: The curved antlers subtly change the flow of air to create a strange space where reality is distorted.

name: 图图犬
description: 会用尾巴前端渗出的体液画下标记。对于有些标记，爱好者会以高价买卖。
englishDescription: A special fluid oozes from the tip of its tail. It paints the fluid everywhere to mark its territory.

name: 无畏小子
description: 体型偏小却不可轻视，因为它只要发现合适的对手便会马上扑上去大打出手。
englishDescription: It is always bursting with energy. To make itself stronger, it keeps on fighting even if it loses.

name: 战舞郎
description: 会通过倒立来扰乱对方的节奏，然后趁隙施展华丽的踢击。
englishDescription: If you are enchanted by its smooth, dance-like kicks, you may get a closer experience with one than you’d like.

name: 迷唇娃
description: 好奇心旺盛的宝可梦。不管是什么都会试着用嘴唇去触碰，确认是否喜欢。
englishDescription: Its lips are the most sensitive part of its body. It always uses its lips first to examine things.

name: 电击怪
description: 储存电力的本领还不到家。为了吸取电力，会偷偷潜入民宅寻找插座。
englishDescription: It rotates its arms to generate electricity, but it tires easily, so it only charges up a little bit.

name: 鸭嘴宝宝
description: 栖息在火山地带。会浸泡在岩浆中，疗愈一整天的疲劳。
englishDescription: Each and every time it inhales and exhales, hot embers dribble from its mouth and nostrils.

name: 大奶罐
description: 如果不每天帮它挤鲜奶，它的身体就会不舒服。鲜奶的味道会随季节改变。
englishDescription: Its milk is packed with nutrition, making it the ultimate beverage for the sick or weary.

name: 幸福蛋
description: 会生下装满幸福的奇妙之蛋。据说，吃下它的蛋的人，能够对所有人都温柔相待。
englishDescription: Anyone who takes even one taste of Blissey’s egg becomes unfailingly caring and pleasant to everyone.

name: 雷公
description: 奔跑时像闪电一样迅疾，吼声会震动空气，仿佛雷鸣就在身旁。
englishDescription: The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will. They say that it descended with lightning.

name: 炎帝
description: 传说它与火山的喷发相伴而生，奔跑时能释放炽烈的火焰。
englishDescription: Volcanoes erupt when it barks. Unable to contain its sheer power, it races headlong around the land.

name: 水君
description: 在大地上优雅地奔跑，拥有净化污水的力量，常让人联想到清澈的泉水。
englishDescription: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.

name: 幼基拉斯
description: 以吃土为生。吃掉一座大山后，就会为了成长而开始沉睡。
englishDescription: It feeds on soil. After it has eaten a large mountain, it falls asleep so it can grow.

name: 沙基拉斯
description: 虽然是蛹却不会呆着不动。在坚硬的甲壳之下已经长出了手脚。
englishDescription: Its shell is as hard as sheet rock, and it is also very strong. Its thrashing can topple a mountain.

name: 班基拉斯
description: 当它带着巨大轰鸣声迈开脚步，就连大山都会为之崩裂，周围的地形也会因此改变。
englishDescription: Its body can’t be harmed by any sort of attack, so it is very eager to make challenges against enemies.

name: 洛奇亚
description: 翅膀轻轻拍动就能掀起强风，因此长久栖身于远离人群的深海。
englishDescription: It is said that it quietly spends its time deep at the bottom of the sea because its powers are too strong.

name: 凤王
description: 羽毛会随光线角度呈现七彩光泽。传说见到它的人会得到幸福。
englishDescription: Legends claim this Pokémon flies the world’s skies continuously on its magnificent, seven-colored wings.

name: 时拉比
description: 从未来穿越时光而来。能够治愈伤痛，也会把自己的力量分给草木。
englishDescription: This Pokémon wanders across time. Grass and trees flourish in the forests in which it has appeared.
